class AggregationDropout(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        nuc = x.abs().mean() ** self.n_n
        sol = bernoulli(1 - self.k_sol * nuc)
        new_insol = bernoulli(self.k_insol * nuc)
        self.perm_mask *= (1 - new_insol)
        return x * sol * self.perm_mask

class GTPaseSwitch(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        gtp_f = self.gtp_pool / (self.gtp_pool + self.gdp_pool)
        y = gtp_f * self.transform(x) + (1-gtp_f) * x
        self.gtp_pool -= 0.1 * y.abs().mean()
        self.gdp_pool += 0.1 * y.abs().mean()
        return y
